card.name: Sentence-opening words like Last reviewed
card.fires_on: The word "Last" starting a footer line such as "Last reviewed" or "Last modified" after a health article. It also fires on "such" in "such as" lists and on a few other sentence-opening words.

modes.label: Last reviewed footer
modes.description: "Last" opens a page-footer date line after the article text ends.
modes.example: It may also appear in people who have another medical problem, such as anemia or kidney problems. <<Last>> reviewed on 10/05

modes.label: Such as after a comma
modes.description: "such" introduces an example list after a reference link or phrase.
modes.example: Eat foods rich in Reference folic acid Opens New Window,<< such>> as fortified breakfast cereals and breads

modes.label: Other sentence openers
modes.description: A descriptive word like "single" or "opening" appears right after "the" in general web text.
modes.example: The<< opening>> page contains the following quote from Thomas Jefferson
